description: This Go source file defines options and methods for enabling/disabling Kubernetes API resources via command-line flags, including validation and application of configuration settings.

classes.name: APIEnablementOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration for enabling/disabling API resources and related flags.

methods.name: AddFlags
methods.description: Adds command-line flags for API enablement options to a FlagSet.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the runtime configuration against registered API groups.

methods.name: ApplyTo
methods.description: Applies the enablement options to a server configuration, merging resource configs and handling version warnings.

methods.name: NewAPIEnablementOptions
methods.description: Creates a new instance of APIEnablementOptions with default settings.
